slides.heading: 1 — The "Hard Question" Prompt
body: Here is my situation: [DESCRIBE IT IN 3-4 SENTENCES]. My #1 goal is [GOAL + DEADLINE].
Don't give me advice yet. First, ask me the 3 hardest questions a top advisor would ask before saying anything. Then wait for my answers.

slides.heading: 2 — The "Steelman" Prompt
body: Make the strongest possible case AGAINST it. Assume I'm missing something obvious. List the 3 ways this fails and what I'd need to believe for it to still be the right call.

slides.heading: 3 — The "One Reader" Prompt
body: Rewrite this so it speaks to ONE person: [PASTE YOUR TEXT].
That person is [WHO THEY ARE + WHAT THEY'RE WORRIED ABOUT]. Cut anything they wouldn't care about. Keep it under 120 words.

slides.heading: 4 — The "Turn It Into a System" Prompt
body: Here's a task I do over and over: [DESCRIBE IT].
Write me a step-by-step checklist a brand-new assistant could follow to do it exactly like I would, including the mistakes to avoid at each step.

slides.heading: 5 — The "Pressure Test" Prompt
body: Score it 1-10 on how likely it is to actually work. Be honest, not nice. Then tell me the single highest-leverage change that would move that score up the most.
